description: One-call summary of tonight at a place: aurora chances (Kp), the next naked-eye satellite pass and cultural asterisms from Ciel des peuples. Use it for an overview; for details call aurora, iss_passes or first_skies directly, and for a score of observing conditions use observation_conditions. Combines live Vigi-Sky API data; by default ignores daylight passes. Not a UFO forecast.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

lat.description: Observer latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (north positive).

lng.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

lon.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

night_only.description: true (default): only passes in a dark sky. false: include daylight ISS passes.

name: tonight_sky

outputSchema.description: Returns observer_sun_altitude, observer_condition, next_pass, aurora, asterisms, not_a_ufo_forecast.

title: Tonight's sky summary
